Over 8M HYPE was staked in the first day following the ANIME announcement that some tokens would go to HYPE stakers. Chainalysis acquired Fraud Detection firm Alterya for $150M to help its efforts in stopping scammers. Layer Zero went live on Soneium, Sony's new EVM L2. Tether is moving to El Salvador after acquiring a Digital Asset Service Provider license in the Bitcoin-friendly country. Donald Trump is expected to issue several Crypto-focused executive orders on his first day according to the Washington Post, including a repeal of a crypto accounting policy (SAB 121) and de-banking of Crypto companies. Donald Trump's inauguration will feature a "Crypto Ball" to honor him as the "first Crypto President," with tickets available for $5,000/person. A US Court demanded the SEC explain itself for denying Coinbase's requests related to crypto regulations. MicroStrategy bought another $243M worth of Bitcoin at a $95,972 average this past week. A BlackRock report said that crypto has "outpaced growth for mobile phones and the internet" in its race to 300M users.

entry.title: Crypto Rebounds, Stocks wipe out Election gains, AI agents leads Strength
entry.summary: BTC hits $89k then rebounds strongly. Trump prepares several crypto EOs on day 1. SOL, XRP ETPs could attract $15bn inflows: JPM. Tether moves HQ from BVI to El Salvador. Trump to have $1m per head Crypto Ball. Binance to face US class action lawsuit. Meta’s board advised to buy BTC with treasury. Semler Scientific buys $221mm BTC. Ming Shing buys 500 BTC. Italian bank Intesa Sanpaolo buys 11 BTC. Remixpoint buys $32mm BTC. Latest crypto MacOS malware overblown: Apple. BTC adoption outpaces phones & internet: Blackrock. Blackrock BTC ETF launched in Canada. Crypto bank Sygnum hits unicorn status . Robinhood to pay $45m in SEC settlement. Warren encourages Besse.

entry.title: BTC below $91K, Dollar at 2-year High, AI Crypto faces Deep sell-off
entry.summary: BTC below $91k on strong dollar & inflation fears. MicroStrategy buys $243m more BTC. BTC consolidates below 20-day EMA. BTC dominance rises, XRP outperforms. Two more US states consider BTC reserves. Bessent to divest $250-500k BTC ETF holdings. FDIC official criticises crypto restrictions. FTX to start repaying creditors post Jan 20. Dimon compares BTC to smoking. Trump’s crypto promises could time: NYDIG. Geraci predicts 50 new crypto ETFs in 2025. Mango Markets shuts down post SEC settlement. USD0 stablecoin briefly falls below 0.9. CFPB targets wallet makers. ONDO to see 20% unlock this week. Moonpay acquires Helio Pay.

entry.title: Crypto Rebounds, Banana Singularity Coming, Binance lists AI coins
entry.summary: BTC drops to $91k before 12 straight green candles. Crypto headed for Banana Singularity: Raoul Pal. Fidelity prefers ETH over SOL on fundamentals. Pro-crypto CFTC boss rumoured. Lummis to lead Senate crypto subcommittee. Steil to lead House crypto subcommittee. Sol Strategies raising $20m to expand SOL staking. Circle donates $1m USDC for Trump inauguration. Backpack and FTX clash over FTX EU sale. 56% of US advisers eye crypto in ‘25: Bitwise. CleanSpark now fourth miner to hold 10k BTC. Block may be first BTC firm in S&P500: VanEck . Russia to sell BTC seized in Infraud hacking case. Staking isn’t a collective investment scheme: UK. Judge rejects $770m BTC landfill hard drive case. StanChart to offer crypto custody services in EU. MiCA could boost Euro stablecoins: JP Morgan. Crypto is booming in China. Thailand seizes 996 illegal BTC mining rigs.

entry.title: Crypto Weak, Silk Road BTC Approved for Sale, Market top worries.
entry.summary: BTC continues to fall, many altcoins down 10%+. US approved to sell $6.5bn Silk road BTC. BTC ETFs see second biggest outflow ever. 75% chance of market top: Ansem. Kraken, a16z execs in running for CFTC chair. Oklahoma senator introduces BTC Freedom Act. Outgoing CFTC chair still pushing crypto regulation. XRP CEO Garlinghouse meets Trump. XRP’s RLUSD to list on more exchanges soon. SOL pushes validators to test Firedancer upgrade. Do Kwon’s trial set for Jan 2026. ETH foundation sells 100 ETH. FTX bankruptcy managers accused of misspending. FTX bankruptcy estate disputes sale of FTX EU. Thailand to pilot crypto payments in Phuket.

entry.title: Crypto Crash, Inflation fears return, MLG hits $100M
entry.summary: Crypto crashes amidst escalating inflation fears. MicroStrategy plans $2bn capital raise to buy BTC.ETFs buying BTC 20x faster than it is being mined. Nation BTC adoption to drive crypto: Fidelity. Czech national bank considers BTC reserve. S. Korea to lift institutional crypto trading ban. BTC sell side liquidity at lowest level since 2018. XRP ETF could soon be a reality: XRP President. CFTC chair Behnam to step down effective Jan 20. Vitalik wants decentralized defence against AI. Coinbase gets major court win against SEC. Arbitrum collabs with S. Korea’s Lotte Group. Bitfinex Derivatives to move to El Salvador. Finnish police seize $2.6m from Hex founder. Coinbase receives virtual currency license in NY.
